policy: The mandatory gate set of a delivery is decided by this registry, never by the caller of the Green Keeper. A gate may be added here; it may not be dropped by an invocation. A gate listed here must be executable wherever the delivery is worked on: the Foundation gates need Docker, which Gate 0 makes a hard requirement of the repository, but none of them needs the whole stack to be running, because a gate that does would be skipped rather than fixed.

gates.title: Full unit and integration suite
gates.purpose: Green Keeper gate: the full unit and integration suite must be green before handoff.

gates.title: Static analysis of the tooling and the suite
gates.purpose: Green Keeper gate: static analysis of the ledger tooling and the suite.

gates.title: Engineering memory validation
gates.purpose: Green Keeper gate: the engineering memory must stay valid, with every GUARDED lesson backed by a resolvable control.

gates.title: Checkpoint chain and tag integrity
gates.purpose: Green Keeper gate: the sealed checkpoint chain, its tags, commits and trees must still match their recorded anchors.

gates.title: Checkpoint validation and repository secret scan
gates.purpose: Green Keeper gate: checkpoint validation, which also runs the repository secret scan.

gates.title: Foundation backend unit suite
gates.purpose: Green Keeper gate: the API unit suite, executed in the API image with no dependency on a running stack.

gates.title: Model Gateway suite
gates.purpose: Green Keeper gate: the Model Gateway's own suite — contracts, protocol adapters, catalog, routing, resilience, streaming and secret containment — executed in the API image against deterministic doubles, with no dependency on a running stack or on a provider credential.

gates.title: Foundation frontend build and suite
gates.purpose: Green Keeper gate: the Angular production build and the frontend suite, executed in the frontend toolchain image.

gates.title: Static analysis of the Foundation source
gates.purpose: Green Keeper gate: ruff over the backend, the worker, the packages and the operational tooling, and the TypeScript compiler and Prettier over the frontend.

gates.title: Infrastructure declaration
gates.purpose: Green Keeper gate: the infrastructure the stack declares — pinned images, loopback-only ports, real health conditions, no committed credential.
